title: Q-STD-ledgers: Convert baseline ledgers to CloudEvents
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation openstd --probe event-ledgers-cloudevents
**Status:** closed

OPEN-STANDARDS-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-25): convert each ledger family in doctrine/open-standards-baseline.json to CloudEvents 1.0 by changing its writer to openstd.cloudevent() and its reader to read event.data, one family per change, then remove it from the baseline.

size: M
**Out of scope:** new formats not in doctrine/open-standards.json.

Prediction: open_standards_adopted_rows >= 10 within 168 h

**Closing probe:** python3 -m foundation openstd --check passes and the registry row for event-ledgers-cloudevents reads adopted with evidence files that exist.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-26T12:44:52Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
